part.text: {"program": [{"kind": "config_ex", "dataflow": 1}, {"kind": "config_ld", "slot": 0, "stride_bytes": 32, "scale": 1.0}, {"kind": "config_ld", "slot": 1, "stride_bytes": 80, "scale": 1.0}, {"kind": "config_st", "stride_bytes": 320}, {"kind": "mvin", "slot": 0, "buf": "A", "offset": 0, "spad_addr": 0, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "mvin", "slot": 0, "buf": "A", "offset": 16, "spad_addr": 16, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"for": "n", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "M // 16"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"kind": "mvin", "slot": 1, "buf": "B", "offset": {"expr": "16 * n"}, "spad_addr": 32, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "preload", "bd_spad_addr": 32, "out_addr": 2684354560}, {"kind": "compute", "accumulated": false, "a_spad_addr": 0, "bd_spad_addr": 4294967295}, {"kind": "mvin", "slot": 1, "buf": "B", "offset": {"expr": "80 + 16 * n"}, "spad_addr": 48, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "preload", "bd_spad_addr": 48, "out_addr": 3758096384}, {"kind": "compute", "accumulated": false, "a_spad_addr": 16, "bd_spad_addr": 4294967295}, {"kind": "mvout", "buf_offset": {"expr": "16 * n"}, "acc_addr": 2684354560, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}]}, {"kind": "fence"}], "rationale": "A's two 16x16 tiles are loaded once into scratchpad rows 0 and 16 (slot 0, stride 32 bytes), giving minimal A traffic of 512 bytes reused across all 5 column blocks. For each of the 5 N-blocks (n = 0..4, M//16 = 5), the two B tiles (k = 0 and k = 16, stride 80 bytes) are streamed into scratchpad rows 32 and 48 (reused each iteration, fitting the 80-row scratchpad). Each block: preload B(k=0) with overwrite-mode out_addr (bit31|bit29 = 2684354560, acc row 0), compute with A tile 0; preload B(k=16) with accumulate-mode out_addr (bit31|bit30|bit29 = 3758096384), compute with A tile 0 at spad 16 accumulating; then mvout the 16x16 accumulator to C element offset 16*n with store stride 320 bytes (80 int32). K=32 satisfies K*16384 <= 2147483647 with in-order k=0 then k=16 reduction per block. Total mvin bytes: 2*256 (A) + 10*256 (B) = 3072, the minimum since all 10 B tiles and 2 A tiles are distinct and each loaded exactly once. Command count minimized by hoisting A loads out of the loop; a final fence completes the stream."}
